CW3s:r3-bots.notes:
Adept's quiet stretch and Ulkro's late ult are both fixed on untuned windows, and the items gate stays above 2.5 (2.60 / 2.65). Commit 9abf783f is pushed.

Changes:
- Adept contests an enemy start at a camp, reads a kill at 0.8, and has laning retreat bias -0.04.
- For every tier, the jungler gank read reaches further up the road from 8:00 and leaves a camp for a target under 60 % health.
- An ultimate stance or form is spent on any enemy fighter in reach. In practice this only affects Ulkro's Long Run.
- Bug fixed in economy.ts: bots bought back a consumable they had just sold for room, looping on every full bag. A lampglass bought 38-51 lamps across a two-team game (about 25 each) and set about 9. A 45 s no-refill guard fixes it, which is also what gives items their margin.
- The soak gains a --trace diagnostic flag; modes_economy.md records the round.

Tried and dropped:
- A flat +0.08 on the trade edge: stretch 3.2 min, takedowns down.
- A slower lamp cadence: the cadence was not the cost, the buy-back loop was.

Caveats:
- Medians swing by about 0.4 min between windows, so a future window can still land near a bar.
- Items margin is thin on some windows: 2.52 on r3d, before the last tweak.
- Lone deaths to Wicks read 5.2 % at adept on r3d (bar 5) before the last tweak; final code reads 3.1, 3.4 and 2.6 %.
- BRIDGE (15.5 min) and FRAY passed on r3c, before the adept retreat tweak. That tweak only applies to RIFT laning. The novice mirror and all veteran figures also predate it.
- The ruling 22 balance band was not re-measured here.
